item.title: Show HN: Ducky Media for macOS, private cloud hosting for your audio library
item.summary: It's an early version, but usable. A few caveats: - macOS only for this version. Have to start somewhere! - It is a subscription service but the first week is free, so you can sign up and cancel if you just want to play around. I wrote a pretty broad survey of the architecture here: https://tympanon.llc/blog/2026-08-24-ducky-tech In case you want to get into the weeds about the choices, ops, or about specific audio formats. Main product site: https://ducky.tympanon.llc . I thought there would be at least a few people on HN who are digital media holdouts and have a take on new entries in this area.
